rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: half of the required hours, current BLS, plus the 3 opioid hours to prescribe opioids and 6 sedation hours for sedation permit holders.

topics.who: Dentists who prescribe opioid medication (condition of prescribing)
Current BLS, also at first renewal; online only with hands-on component; max 3 BLS h count

rules.notes: Biennial term Jan 1 of even years to Dec 31 of odd years; current BLS required (max 3 BLS h, max 6 ACLS/PALS h count; online only with hands-on component). Sedation permit holders: 6 of the 40 h in sedation/anesthesia.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers such as accredited colleges, CODA programs, ADA/NDA, ADHA/NDHA and their societies, Board-recognized academies, VA/armed forces, American Academy of Dental Hygiene, ADA CERP, AGD PACE, agencies recognized by the AMA Council on Medical Education, ACCME. No limit on live lectures/seminars, study clubs, academic courses, online courses with exit exam; max 10 h combined for teaching, writing, independent study, distance learning without exam, in-service, etc.
rules.alternatives: Waiver/extension on written request before expiration for prolonged illness or other extenuating circumstances (e.g. military deployment). Inactive licensees need no CE.
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance on the renewal form; keep documentation two years post-renewal; random audits.
rules.legal_basis: 02-313 C.M.R. ch. 13 (Board of Dental Practice, Continuing Education); 32 M.R.S. §§ 18308(4), 18324, 18350, 18351
rules.rule_quote: No license will be renewed unless the licensee has completed 40 credit hours of continuing education directly related to dental practice during the preceding biennial license term as set forth in this subsection and has a current BLS certification.
